main_text.head: GUILIELMI SOMNERI, Cantuariensis, ad verba vetera Germanica, à V.Cl. Justo Lipsio, Epist.Cent.III. ad Belgas, Epist. XLIV. collecta: *Notæ.
Nomina.
main_text.p: Balgi, Ira. vide Balgon] Saxonum Æbyl izny rre, aliàs Æbilhðe, quod ab eorum Æbilgian. i. exasperare, irritare, fluens, irritationem, indignationem, notat.
Abirthu, Postea] Sax, Æpterpham. Aratin, Curis. ut Galli Rufes.
After, Secundùm] Quâ acceptione vox ista nobis Anglis vel hodie nota. Saxonibus Æfteɼ.
After allo, Ufquequaque] Videtur esse after all.

page.notes: The upper part of the page only; the lower text is cut off in this part. Marginal note at right reads "* De his, vide suprà, pag. 143. 144." Some Old English and Saxon words in the entry are doubtful and rendered from a difficult print; the Saxon forms "Æbyl izny rre" and "Æbilhðe" are uncertain. The second entry head "Abirthu" is doubtful. Catchword and signature are read from the foot of the scan; the Greek word "Æfteɼ" and the black-letter headwords are transcribed as best read. Some headwords in black letter are marked with bold here.
